title: General Motors, LLC: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY (290,408 affected)

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:HATCHBACK HYDRAULIC CYLINDER:TRUNK CYLIN (112,000 affected)
summary: SOME LIFTGATE GAS CYLINDER-TO-BODY ATTACHMENT BALL STUDS MAY FRACTURE IN EITHER THE OPEN OR CLOSED POSITION.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LEVER SETTLING (96,541 affected)
summary: THE DESIGN OF THE PARKING BRAKE GRIP MAKES IT POSSIBLE TO DISTORT THE GRIP AND PINCH THE BRAKE RELEASE KNOB. IF THE RELEASE KNOB STICKS IN A PARTIAL ENGAGE/RELEASE POSITION BECAUSE OF THE PINCHED GRIP, IT IS POSSIBLE FOR THE LEVER TO RELEASE UNINTENTIONALLY WITH A CORRESPONDING REDUCTION IN PARKING BRAKE FORCE.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: BRAKES:MECHANICAL SERVICE:PADS AND SHOES (8,405 affected)
summary: FRICTION PAD SEPARATES FROM THE BACKING PLATE AND SUBSEQUENTLY FROM THE FRONT OR REAR BRAKE CALIPER ASSEMBLY.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS (148 affected)
summary: PUSHOUT RECTANGULAR TRANSIT WINDOWS MAY EXCEED 20 POUND RELEASE FORCE.

title: Gillig, LLC: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION (125 affected)
summary: GILLIG CHASSIS MAY HAVE STEERING DRAGLINKS WHICH COULD SEPARATE FROM THE STEERING GEAR PITMAN ARM DUE TO AN ASSEMBLY ERROR THAT  INSTALLED TWP 1/4" SPACERS, WHICH PREVENT PROPER TORQUING BETWEEN THE DRAGLINK AND THE PITMAN ARM.
